verdict.rationale: Figma documents a public REST API covering file and object extraction, webhooks, CRUD on variables, library analytics, and plan or service-style tokens suited to CI/CD automation. An OpenAPI spec and TypeScript types are published on GitHub, and an llms.txt is served. Canvas writes are covered by the documented read/write Plugin API and the official MCP server that lets agents create native content. missing for 10: canvas content creation is not shown through the stateless REST API (it needs the plugin runtime or MCP), the OpenAPI spec is not served at the docs domain, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven API use.
